description.en: VietFashion is a benchmark for sketch-text composed image retrieval centered on the Ao Dai, a traditional Vietnamese garment. It includes 650 sketches expanded to over 21,000 photorealistic images with captions, and adopts a multi-target retrieval setting.

evidence.snippet: We introduce VietFashion, a new benchmark for sketch-text composed image retrieval centered on the Ao Dai, a traditional Vietnamese garment.

claire_radar.motivation: Cultural garments pose a unique challenge for visual retrieval systems, as their identity often depends on subtle structural and symbolic details that are poorly captured by standard AI models.
